_comment: DRAFT contract baseline for ounce.run.v1 (issue #481). tests/contract_v1.rs requires every report to have exactly these keys, each with a value of one of the listed JSON types, and every listed type to occur in at least one representative run. Removing, renaming or retyping a key fails the test. Adding a key fails it too, on purpose: add the key here (and to docs/OUNCE_RUN_V1_SCHEMA.md and docs/CONTRACT_V1.md) in the same change, so the addition is a conscious, reviewed one.

stop_kinds_not_reachable_in_tests.window_closed: needs a host window (--gui) that a test runner does not have
stop_kinds_not_reachable_in_tests.cpu_halted: nothing constructs StepResult::Halt in this tree, so no program can produce it
